mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses equity discount rates through monetary easing expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate continued accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.1% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals economic weakness prompting Federal Reserve rate cuts, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE > 6.5 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 6-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 6-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are above 6-month moving averages over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low industrial production regimes (INDPRO < 100.5), a month-over-month increase in industrial output signals economic recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where INDPRO < 100.5 and INDPRO rises month-over-month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year inflation below 1.5% (CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5%) reduces Fed rate hike probability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days as monetary accommodation is priced in.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change < 1.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Month-over-month nonfarm payrolls growth (PAYEMS) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days through sustained labor market strength.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where PAYEMS increases month-over-month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 900 thousand units (HOUST > 900) signal strong housing sector activity, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where HOUST > 900 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 2.0% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing equity discount rates and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days as corporate profitability expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0 over a 3-year rolling window.
